answer_html:
Definition

The JavaBeans API is the set of classes and interfaces in the java.beans package used to create, inspect and manage beans.

Class / InterfaceUse
IntrospectorAnalyses a bean
BeanInfo / SimpleBeanInfoExplicit bean information
PropertyDescriptorDescribes a property
EventSetDescriptor, MethodDescriptorDescribe events, methods
PropertyChangeListener / Event / SupportBound properties
VetoableChangeListener, PropertyVetoExceptionConstrained properties
PropertyEditor, CustomizerEditing in builder tools
XMLEncoder, XMLDecoderPersistence as XML
BeansUtility, e.g. Beans.instantiate()
